title: The Future of Facebook Ads: Our 2023 Predictions
excerpt: Written in early 2023: the changes we expected to Facebook ads targeting, delivery algorithms, mobile placements, reporting and creative options.
description: Our early-2023 view of how Facebook ads would change: targeting, algorithms, mobile, reporting and ad customisation.
html:
The Future of Facebook Ads: Anticipated Changes by 2023

As one of the leading social media platforms, Facebook is constantly evolving to meet the ever-changing demands of its user base. This means that Facebook Ads have continued to evolve in order to remain effective, and the next few years will bring even more changes. As such, this blog post will explore the five anticipated changes to Facebook Ads by 2023.

1. Updates to Targeting Strategies

Targeting on social media platforms is constantly being refined and updated to ensure that users are being served the most relevant ads. By 2023,Facebook Ads targeting strategies are likely to become even more advanced, incorporating contextual data, AI, and machine learning to determine the most effective users to target with ads.

2. Improved Algorithms for Low-Cost Ads

Facebook Ads is already well-known for its low-cost ads, but with advances in algorithms, it is likely that Facebook will be able to offer even more cost-effective ads to its users. 2023 may see more sophisticated algorithms that are both efficient and economical for users who want to run ads on the platform.

3. Shifting Priorities for Mobile Ads

With the increasing prevalence of smartphones, mobile ads are becoming increasingly important - and Facebook is no exception. By 2023, expect Facebook to prioritize mobile ads even more and introduce new features that better optimize mobile ads for users.

4. Changes to Reporting and Insights

The ability to see insights into the effectiveness of ads is invaluable for tracking and optimizing campaigns. 2023 is likely to see changes to reporting and insights options on Facebook, with deeper and more comprehensive insights into user behavior and ad campaigns.

5. Increased Customization Options for Ads

Customization has become an essential part of the ad-creation process and 2023 could see even more options for users to customize their ads. This could include more visual features, more interactive options, and even enhanced personalization options such as product recommendations.

The advertising landscape is always evolving, and these five anticipated changes to Facebook Ads by 2023 show just how quickly things can change. As such, it's important to stay on top of the latest changes to ensure that you're making the most of your campaigns.
